statement: A CRITICAL production-dependency advisory blocks the Beta unless an exception below proves
it is non-applicable by a mechanically re-checkable predicate.
A HIGH production-dependency advisory blocks unless applicability can be excluded the same way.
MODERATE and LOW findings do not block by themselves; they are recorded here once reviewed so
the gate can tell a reviewed finding from a NEW one, and the gate names every unreviewed one.
A dev-only finding is out of scope for this gate, which audits the production tree only.
A scan that cannot execute is UNKNOWN. It is never PASS.
npm audit repeats one advisory on every dependent; this register lists ROOT advisories only, because the gate collapses propagation before matching.
